arabic text: TERI UMMAT NE MERE DAR KO JALAYA BABA.\nPHIR WO JALTA HOWA DAR MUJH PE GIRAYA BABA.
english translation text: O FATHER, YOUR NATION BURNED MY DOOR AND THEN THEY DROPPED THE BURNING DOOR ONTO ME!

arabic text: RAKH THI SHOLAY THE SEHME HOWAY BACHE YA DHUWAN.\nMERE AANGAN MEIN THA IK SHAM-E-GHAREEBAN KA SAMAA.\nDAR HATA KAR MUJHE FIZA(SA) NE UTHAYA BABA.
english translation text: THERE WERE ASHES AND FLAMES AND DISTRAUGHT CHILDREN. IN FRONT OF ME WAS THE SCENE OF SHAM-E-GHARIBA. AFTER LIFTING THE DOOR, FIZZA HELPED ME GET UP, O FATHER!

arabic text: LAUT KAR AYI TU CHEHRA BHI MERA ZAKHMI THA.\nMERI ZAINAB(SA) KO MERI PESHI KA PEHLA NOHA.\nMERE BALON KI SAFAIDI NE SUNAYA BABA.
english translation text: AS I RETURNED, MY FACE WAS WOUND TOO. THE FIRST EULOGY THAT ZAINAB HEARD WAS THROUGH MY HAIR TURNING WHITE, O FATHER!

arabic text: LE CHALE QAIDI BANA KAR JO ALI(AS) KE DUSHMAN.\nMAIN CHORA NAHI HAIDER(AS) KI ABBA KA DAMAN.\nTAZIYANO NE MAGAR MUJH SE CHORAYA BABA.
english translation text: ALI WAS TAKEN CAPTIVE, I DID NOT LET GO OF HIS CLOAK BUT THE ENEMIES FORCED ME TO LET GO AFTER WHIPPING ME, O FATHER!

arabic text: BAITH KAR PARHTI HOON MUSHKIL SE NAMAZ-E-SHAB BHI.\nPHIR BHI ABBAS(AS) KI KHILQAT KI DUA BHOLI NAHI.\nJAB BHI ZAKHMI HOWAY HATHON KO UTHAYA BABA.
english translation text: WITH DIFFICULTY I SIT TO PRAY NAMAZ-E-SHAB, I DID NOT FORGET TO PRAY FOR THE CREATION OF ABBAS, WHENEVER I LIFTED MY INJURED ARMS FOR DUA, O FATHER!

arabic text: OUR ALI UN WALIULLAH BACHA KAR LAYI.\nZAKHMI HALAT MEIN BHI DEHLEEZ SE BAHIR AYI.\nAHAD JO MAIN NE KIYA THA WOH NIBHAYA BABA.
english translation text: WHILE WOUNDED I CAME OUT TO SAVE THE MESSAGE OF ALI-UN WALIYULLAH. I FULFILLED THE PROMISE WHICH I MADE TO YOU,\nO FATHER!

arabic text: KOAN SA DAR HAI JAHAN AAP KI BETI NA GAYI.\nARE BAAT SUNNA TU KUJA YOUN HOI IZZAT MERI.\nKOI DARWAZE SE BAHIR NAHI AYA BABA.
english translation text: IS THERE A DOOR WHICH I DID NOT GO TO?\nBUT MY DIGNITY WAS SUCH THAT NO ONE CAME TO LISTEN TO ME, O FATHER!

arabic text: KHUD YEH DEKHA HAI TERE SHEHER KI DEWARON NE.\nKAISI GURBAT THI HATHON MEIN SITAM DARON NE.\nRASIYAAN BAND KE HAIDER(AS) KO PHIRAYA BABA.
english translation text: THE WALLS OF MEDINA ARE WITNESS TO THE LONELINESS OF ALI. THE ENEMIES TIED HIM IN ROPES AND PARADED HIM AROUND, O FATHER!

arabic text: JIS JAGA AAP NE RUK RUK KE IJAZAT MANGI.\nWAHAN GUSTAKH MUSALMANO NE BAIYAT MANGI.\nAREY KOI SHOLAY TU KOI LAKRIYAAN LAYA BABA.
english translation text: THE AUDACIOUS ‘MUSLIMS’ ASKED FOR ALLEGIANCE IN THE SAME PLACE WHERE YOU ASKED PERMISSION TO ENTER. SOME BROUGHT FLAMES AND OTHERS BROUGHT FIRE, O FATHER!

arabic text: JIS GHARI RO KE WILAYAT KI SHAHEEDA NE KAHA.\nMUJH KO HANS HANS KE ZAMANE NE RULAYA BABA.
english translation text: ARSH OUR FARSH PE :MUHSIN: HOWA KUHRAM BAPA.\nIN HEAVEN AND EARTH, MUHSIN, THERE WAS A CRY, WHEN THE FIRST MARTYR FOR WILAYAT SAID, 'THE PEOPLE FOUND JOY IN MAKING ME CRY, O FATHER!'
